clues.text: This city lies in a wide basin in South America, on the banks of the Mapocho River. The high Andes rise to its east, and a coast range lies to its west.
clues.narrowing: Rules out all but basin cities in South America between two ranges.

source.quote: Located in the Chilean Central Valley within the Santiago Basin, between the Andes to the east and the Chilean Coastal Range to the west

clues.text: Summers here are warm and dry, with long bright days and next to no rain. Winters are cool and wet, and they bring most of the rain of the year.
clues.narrowing: Rules out wet-summer lands; keeps the dry summer and wet winter swing.

source.quote: The city has a cool semi-arid climate with Mediterranean characteristics, warm, dry summers and cool, wetter winters

clues.text: In 1541, Pedro de Valdivia founded this city to be the seat of his new realm. He laid out its streets in a neat grid round one main square.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to cities founded as a seat of rule in 1541.

source.quote: The city would serve as the capital of his governorship of Nueva Extremadura . On 12 February 1541, Valdivia officially founded the city of Santiago del Nuevo Extremo

clues.text: From this city, the high Andes fill the east sky like a great wall of rock. On clear days, their snowy tops seem to tower right over the streets.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: a wall of high snowy peaks fills the east sky.

source.quote: its location in an enclosed valley contributes both to its scenic views of the high Andes

clues.text: The president of Chile has his palace in this city. The top courts and the chief state offices work here too.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the president's palace and the top courts sit here.

source.quote: it houses the presidential palace and the main organs of the executive and judiciary

reveal.blurb: Pedro de Valdivia founded this city in 1541 as the seat of his new realm, with a grid of streets round a main square. Quakes and floods hit it hard over the years, yet it grew into a vast city under the high Andes. Santiago is the capital of Chile.
